title: Reflective Numeration Systems I: a Global Standpoint
summary: We present a framework to generalize the standard b-ary Gray code to get the k-bonacci ones obtained in [5] as well as many others by using theoretical tools that allow to make calculations on lists. We introduce the notion of Z-Gray product, from which we deduce sequences of lists of finite words avoiding a predefinite list Z of factors and which satisfy a power-associativity property as well a generalizations of the classical flipping digit property.
